population: Original 213 NUAA-SIRST training IDs from the bundled train file. No new split. In-sample diagnostics.
inference: One FP16 greedy-argmax image at a time; TF32 disabled, no AdaIN, RGB arithmetic mean before quantization. Gray native reference before extra noise.
scores: native_v2; image means weighted equally; primary comparison on alpha=1. Curves are descriptive. Only conditions sharing a draw use the same underlying noise field. Noise sigma values are before clipping on the 0-255 scale.
